pages.text:
Splits water with FE: 1 mB of water makes 2 mB of Hydrogen and 1 mB of Oxygen.
- Water costs at least {fe:1416} FE per mB (708 per mB of hydrogen). Brine splits for 600 FE per mB and hydrofluoric acid for 400 FE per mB; Energy upgrades lower those costs, down to the hydrogen floor.
- Water goes in through the top port. Hydrogen leaves west and the second gas (Oxygen, Chlorine or Fluorine) east. Brine also makes Lye, which leaves down. These ports use the default north-facing layout.
- A full gas tank stops processing. Use a wrench on the top to toggle Hydrogen venting, or on the bottom to toggle venting from the second gas tank. Excess gas is discarded while venting is enabled.
- Takes Speed and Energy upgrades. Feed input fluids and connect output tanks through fluid conduits.
